name: Temecula Valley Fall 2024
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TemeculaValleyFall2024#43142-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com):
